mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand, which reduces earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE crosses above 4.5% and remains above for at least two months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative in periods where UNRATE > 4.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) for three consecutive months signals improving supply capacity, which boosts earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO increases for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when INDPRO increases for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and a decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) signals a disinflationary tightening cycle, which reduces discount rates and supports positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive when FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the civilian labor force participation rate (implied from PAYEMS and UNRATE) signals increased labor supply, which boosts productivity and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive when both PAYEMS and UNRATE rise (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) for three consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction-related earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases for three consecutive months
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are not significantly positive when HOUST increases for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) for two consecutive months signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines for two consecutive months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly negative when RSAFS declines for two months (t-test p > 0.05).
